scientific_integrity: An analytical proof for arbitrary full-rank Euclidean lattices is supplied. Independent validation has not been performed. Computational checks only corroborate selected exact rational examples.
scientific_limitations: Population distribution of the squared nearest-versus-second-nearest lattice distance gap, not an unsquared gap or a finite-sample estimator. Tail exponent identifies the dimension of the shortest-vector span, not a full basis, and no quantitative noise robustness is established. Historical priority not fully resolved.
title: Shortest-vector rank from the extreme nearest-site margin of a Euclidean lattice
